lead_raw_text:
The structure of Zn4Zr2O8 (Zn2ZrO4) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 14 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Zn centers as octahedral, each coordinated by six O neighbors, while Zr centers show eight O neighbors. O centers are four-coordinate, surrounded by two Zn and two Zr neighbors. Validated polyhedral contacts reveal corner-sharing between Zn octahedra and corner- and face-sharing between Zn octahedra and Zr 8-vertex polyhedra, forming a 3D connected network.
